q21732.en: The sign shown can be combined with a panel showing the distance to the point where the extra lane starts.

explain.short: A panel under the sign can say how far away the new lane begins.
explain.rule: This blue sign shows a change in the number of lanes: one lane becomes two, as a new lane opens on the right. It is used on roads outside towns.
explain.trap: 'può essere' (can be): the distance panel is possible, not required.

sceneParams.caption: Panel can show distance to the new lane

q21733.en: The sign shown is placed on roads outside towns.

explain.short: The background is blue, the colour of these signs on roads outside towns.
explain.rule: This blue sign shows a change in the number of lanes: one lane becomes two, as a new lane opens on the right. It is used on roads outside towns.
explain.trap: 'extraurbane' (outside towns): the blue background tells you the road type.

sceneParams.caption: Blue: roads outside towns

q21734.en: The sign shown indicates that you are near an overpass that lets you turn back.

explain.short: There is no U-turn arrow: the arrows go forward and show a new lane.
explain.rule: This blue sign shows a change in the number of lanes: one lane becomes two, as a new lane opens on the right. It is used on roads outside towns.
explain.trap: 'cavalcavia' (overpass): the U-turn sign has a curved arrow going back.

sceneParams.caption: Not a U-turn: a lane is added

q21735.en: The sign shown gives advance warning of a compulsory right turn.

explain.short: It is a blue square information sign about lanes, not a blue disc obligation; the bent arrow just moves into the new lane.
explain.rule: This blue sign shows a change in the number of lanes: one lane becomes two, as a new lane opens on the right. It is used on roads outside towns.
explain.trap: 'obbligo' (obligation): the bent arrow is a new lane, not a forced turn.

sceneParams.caption: No obligation: a new lane opens

q21736.en: The sign shown indicates that you may pass an obstacle on the right or on the left.

explain.short: There is no obstacle: the two arrows show one lane becoming two.
explain.rule: This blue sign shows a change in the number of lanes: one lane becomes two, as a new lane opens on the right. It is used on roads outside towns.
explain.trap: 'ostacolo' (obstacle): the 'pass on either side' sign is a blue disc, not this square.

sceneParams.caption: Not an obstacle: one lane becomes two

keywords.it: passare a destra o a sinistra
keywords.en: pass on the right or left

q21737.en: The sign shown indicates that overtaking on the right is possible.

explain.short: The sign only tells you a lane is added; it gives no permission to overtake on the right.
explain.rule: This blue sign shows a change in the number of lanes: one lane becomes two, as a new lane opens on the right. It is used on roads outside towns.
explain.trap: 'sorpassare a destra' (overtake on the right): the sign says nothing about overtaking.

sceneParams.caption: Lane added; overtake on the left as usual

q21738.en: The sign shown gives advance warning of a pre-selection zone.

explain.short: A pre-selection zone has lanes with arrows to different directions before a junction; here both lanes go straight on.
explain.rule: This blue sign shows a change in the number of lanes: one lane becomes two, as a new lane opens on the right. It is used on roads outside towns.
explain.trap: 'preselezione' (choosing your lane before a junction): both arrows here point forward.

sceneParams.caption: Not pre-selection: both lanes go ahead

q21739.en: The sign shown gives advance warning of a deceleration lane.

explain.short: A deceleration lane is for leaving the road; here the new lane continues straight on next to the other one.
explain.rule: This blue sign shows a change in the number of lanes: one lane becomes two, as a new lane opens on the right. It is used on roads outside towns.
explain.trap: 'decelerazione' (slowing down to exit): the new lane goes forward, it does not leave the road.

sceneParams.caption: Not an exit lane: an extra lane ahead

q21740.en: The sign shown indicates a decrease in the number of available lanes.

explain.short: The right lane bends into the middle one and ends, so there are fewer lanes.
explain.rule: This green motorway sign shows that three lanes become two: the right lane ends and merges into the middle one, so slow down.
explain.trap: 'diminuzione' (decrease): three lanes become two.

sceneParams.caption: Fewer lanes ahead: three become two

q21741.en: The sign shown indicates a reduction from three to two lanes.

explain.short: Two arrows go straight and the third bends in and ends: three lanes become two.
explain.rule: This green motorway sign shows that three lanes become two: the right lane ends and merges into the middle one, so slow down.
explain.trap: 'da tre a due' (from three to two): count the arrows at the bottom and at the top.

sceneParams.caption: From three lanes to two

q21742.en: The sign shown advises slowing down because the roadway narrows.

explain.short: With one lane less, cars must merge, so it is wise to slow down.
explain.rule: This green motorway sign shows that three lanes become two: the right lane ends and merges into the middle one, so slow down.
explain.trap: 'consiglia' (advises): the sign informs, and slowing down is the right advice.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down: the roadway narrows

q21743.en: The sign shown can be combined with a panel showing the distance to the lane narrowing.

explain.short: A panel under the sign can say how far away the lane ends.
explain.rule: This green motorway sign shows that three lanes become two: the right lane ends and merges into the middle one, so slow down.
explain.trap: 'può essere' (can be): the distance panel is possible, not required.

sceneParams.caption: Panel can show distance to the narrowing

q21744.en: The sign shown is installed on motorways.

explain.short: The background is green, the colour of motorway signs.
explain.rule: This green motorway sign shows that three lanes become two: the right lane ends and merges into the middle one, so slow down.
explain.trap: 'autostrade' (motorways): the green colour tells you the road type.

sceneParams.caption: Green background = motorway

explain.short: Roadworks have a red triangle warning sign; this green sign only shows that a lane ends.
explain.rule: This green motorway sign shows that three lanes become two: the right lane ends and merges into the middle one, so slow down.
explain.trap: 'lavori in corso' (roadworks): the green sign is about lanes, not works.

sceneParams.caption: Not roadworks: a lane ends

q21746.en: The sign shown gives advance warning of a compulsory left turn.

explain.short: The bent arrow is the right lane merging, not a turn; and a green square informs, it does not oblige.
explain.rule: This green motorway sign shows that three lanes become two: the right lane ends and merges into the middle one, so slow down.
explain.trap: 'obbligo' (obligation): the arrow means 'move into the next lane', not 'turn left'.

sceneParams.caption: No left turn: the right lane merges

q21747.en: The sign shown gives advance warning of an overpass that allows a U-turn.

explain.short: There is no U-turn arrow: all arrows go forward, and one lane ends.
explain.rule: This green motorway sign shows that three lanes become two: the right lane ends and merges into the middle one, so slow down.
explain.trap: 'inversione di marcia' (U-turn): that sign has a curved arrow going back.

sceneParams.caption: Not a U-turn: a lane ends

q21748.en: The sign shown indicates that you must give way to vehicles entering the motorway.

explain.short: The sign shows a lane that ends, not an entry ramp; it gives no give-way rule for traffic already on the motorway.
explain.rule: This green motorway sign shows that three lanes become two: the right lane ends and merges into the middle one, so slow down.
explain.trap: 'entrano in autostrada' (entering the motorway): the bent arrow is a lane ending, not an entry.

sceneParams.caption: Not an entry: the right lane ends
